Class DatabaseManager

java.lang.Object
DatabaseManager
public class DatabaseManager extends Object
Steven Piskunov CEN-3024C - Software Development I November 8, 2026 DatabaseManager.java This Data Access Object class manages SQLite database connectivity via JDBC for the RetroVault DMS. It provides CRUD query execution, connection lifecycle management, and parameterized SQL statements to safeguard against SQL injection and database corruption.

  • Method Details

    • connect

      public boolean connect(String dbPath) throws SQLException
      Establishes a JDBC connection to the SQLite database file supplied by the user, creates the 'games' table if it does not yet exist, and returns true upon success.
      Parameters:
      dbPath - the file path to the SQLite database
      Returns:
      true if connection and table initialization succeed
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the path is blank or connection fails

    • initializeTable

      public boolean initializeTable() throws SQLException
      Executes a DDL statement ensuring the 'games' relation exists with all six required domain attributes and a primary key constraint.
      Returns:
      true if table creation succeeds
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs

    • getAllGames

      public List<VideoGame> getAllGames() throws SQLException
      Queries all rows from the 'games' table, reconstructs VideoGame domain objects, and returns an in-memory list sorted ascending by gameId.
